references.text: Parallel description of the bronze grate (lattice) that was placed under the ledge of the altar, down to the middle of the altar, as a fulfillment of the instructions given here.
Previous verse describing the bronze grate itself (the lattice) with its four bronze rings in the corners, which this verse continues to give instructions about.
Basic instructions regarding the construction of the altar, providing context for the more detailed specifications on the design of the altar in the tabernacle.
